notes.title: New update: Sounds and more.
notes.notes:
- New sound effects for: Gun, MP5, explosions, Fn-Fal, Ithaca, bullet impacts on cars, surfaces and people, car crashes, destruction of objects and car doors.
- HUD order changes.
- Added Dash/Roll (Pressing Space).
- New code: "caosextremo". (Survive the chaos, if you can)
- Secret tank (Find it if you can).

notes.title: Assorted changes!
notes.notes:
Alpha 1.1.3
- New mechanic: Dash/Roll (Pressing space)
- Sparks when hitting the bullets against objects.
- More visible blood (redder and larger).
- Cops now always get out of the police car when chasing you.
- NPCS turn red when taking damage.
- Weapon recoil animation slightly changed
- UI sound change.
- Added exhaust pipe smoke to cars.
- Added car wheel marks when braking.
- General bug fixes.

notes.title: Graphic update
notes.notes:
I updated the lighting engine of Conur Life from the conventional one, to the Universal Pipeline system (Lights 2D) so that the lights look much more beautiful, as well as added a better post processing, and a change in the textures of the grass / grass .
